subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should the canonical fix for the linked stale orphan-prompt bug drop selected internal inter-session leaves from the fresh prompt, or should maintainers prefer the broader preserve-as-context repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both open candidates target the same canonical issue but choose different session-state semantics, and this review cannot safely decide that product/runtime contract without maintainer intent and real runtime proof.

options.title: Require proof before selecting
options.body: Keep both candidate PRs open until this PR has redacted embedded-runner proof and maintainers choose the canonical drop-versus-preserve semantics.

options.title: Land the drop strategy
options.body: Proceed with this PR only if maintainers accept the six-source predicate scope and have sufficient runtime proof for both dropping internal handoffs and preserving `sessions_send`.

options.title: Prefer the proven broader repair
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical path if maintainers want preserve-as-context semantics and its existing live proof is sufficient.

recommendation.title: Require proof before selecting
recommendation.body: Keep both candidate PRs open until this PR has redacted embedded-runner proof and maintainers choose the canonical drop-versus-preserve semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant queued-user merge behavior and recent prompt-helper maintenance history point most directly to this area owner signal.
